notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.4.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug relating to parallax that occasionally caused crashes
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused lava to appear on the wrong depth layer
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed health regen to only happen on combat levels or levels with crossbow turrets
[*]Adjusted Level 8-20 layout
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.4.1
notes.content:
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Jean Chevalier de Gatineau health decreased from 1000 to 750
[*]Starting health regen starts after 3 failed attempts
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug related to parallax backgrounds that would sometimes cause crashes on level start
[*]Fixed slo-mo tutorial sign to show button for gamepad users
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]Enabled debug mode: press F1 to toggle
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.4.0
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Player will now fall if airborne while in "slam" state, e.g. when fastfalling onto a crumbling platform that disappears
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Converted game to GMS2 runtime v2022.8
[*] Added game completion achievement
[*] Added leaderboard to contain list of players who have completed game in order of completion
[/list]
